【Attention】Summary of major overseas FX brokers' response to the payment-agency regulation

Less than one month remains until the end of the grace period of the amended Payment Services Act.

Myforex has compiled the regulatory response status of major brokers that it surveyed when the amended Payment Services Act took effect (as of July 2026).

📌Regulatory response status
・Axi: Reset past deposit history in May
・XM: Reset past deposit history in July
・XS: Will consult on changes to withdrawal methods
・BigBoss: No change to withdrawal rules
・Exness: No change to withdrawal rules
・FXGT: No change to withdrawal rules
・HFM: No change to withdrawal rules
・ThreeTrader: No change to withdrawal rules
・TitanFX: No change to withdrawal rules

Axi and XM have already carried out a special measure of resetting deposit history made by domestic bank transfer.

On the other hand, as of November, many major brokers are maintaining their conventional withdrawal rules. However, since even brokers marked "no change" say they will promptly notify users if their policy changes, it may be a good idea to check information regularly from December onward.

👇Can you still withdraw if domestic bank transfers stop?
https://t.co/4KZPjj4MmP

*Regarding the MEXC regulation, we are currently organizing the information and are also making inquiries to each company.

You can scalp USD/JPY with a spread of 0.4-0.6. Unrealized losses never exceeded -4 pips, so across 120 trades there was no stop-loss. The profit is small, but I was able to close all of them in profit.
MT4 speed orders also had no problems with execution. They're fast enough.
The spread is about 0.2 wider than domestic brokers, so you have to concentrate on entries. It's quite tiring.
If you have margin, domestic is easier to trade and brings more profit. Considering a 0.2 spread over 120 trades, with 100 lots per shot, domestic earns 240,000 yen more. People with capital: domestic. People without capital: overseas. You can win overseas too.

📊 Analyst Nick's USD/JPY outlook for today
🎯 Nick's key point: The US dollar rose after the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) came in above market expectations. The market expects a 0.25% rate hike at the next FOMC, with about a 10% probability of a large 0.50% hike.

Because the dollar's strength continues, buying dips is still considered an effective strategy. However, continued caution is needed about the possibility of currency intervention by the Bank of Japan.

Next focus is US PPI on Friday.
📈 Above market expectations → Bullish for USD/JPY
📉 Below market expectations → Bearish for USD/JPY

Gold that fell below 4,054.34. What I want to look at now is not "did it get cheaper" but the role of the previous day's low.

As of 06:52 on November 11, XS's MT5 XAUUSDc is at 4,031.61. Because prices differ between data sources, I will unify the levels drawn on the chart using this data.

【What changed on the daily chart】
The previous day's close was 4,141.02. This daily candle has moved from a high of 4,146.63 to a low of 4,013.67, and the current price is below the previous day's low of 4,054.34.

I do not decide here that "it fell a lot, so it will bounce." Can it return inside the range of the previous day, or will it stay outside? First, I look at this difference.

【Upside is the wall after a rebound】
The focus is the round number 4,050.00 to the previous day's low of 4,054.34. It is a zone where I want to check whether the level it broke below turns into one that holds back rebounds.

If price breaks above this zone and also stays on the upper side at the candle close, then the reaction between the 4-hour SMA20 of 4,084.72 and the round number 4,100.00 is the next thing to observe. It is a way of thinking that looks at how far a move back into the previous day's range continues.

【On the downside, separate the trough from the low】
On the 4-hour chart, SMA50 at 4,025.45 and the recent trough at 4,027.44 are close together. The current price is above this zone, but this daily candle's low has already passed through it to the downside. I do not treat it as a "support that has never broken."

If price falls below this zone again and cannot stay above it even after a rebound, I will observe the zone of this daily/this week's low of 4,013.67 and the round number 4,000.00. I separate whether it breaks 4,013.67 and keeps making new lows, or returns with a wick. If it also falls below 4,000.00 and settles there, the downside range could widen.

【Why hide looks at them separately】
On the 4-hour chart, SMA20 is above SMA50. Meanwhile, price is below SMA20. The state shown by the arrangement of the averages and the current price are not aligned.

In verifying the hide-style indicator and range EA too, I want to record this phase separately from usual rebounds within the range. I will compare whether it was only a pass by wick or the close stayed outside the zone, and the subsequent price movement.

The daily ATR is about $93.1, but it is not a number showing the remaining range. In line with the size of price movement, I consider the trade volume from the loss amount I can tolerate.

Trade at your own discretion.
Verification notes are published in the open chat "Hide Gold FX Study Group" in my profile.
